claim: Graphs capture future task structure and the companion bars compare reported policy success across four settings.
family: task-by-horizon graph overlay above four benchmark facets
limitations: The twelve author frames are image-only crops, separate from graph geometry. The bar chart uses numbers from Tables 1-4, not new trials. Rounded corners, hatching and font metrics are redrawn.

reported_values.source: CVPR Tables 1, 2, 3, 4. For Tables 1 and 3 use arithmetic mean across the five LIBERO columns. For Tables 2 and 4 use Overall. BC-Full-Trainset not included in the paper figure.
